response.sql:
WITH invoice_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_quantity,
    (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) / SUM(derived_total_cost) as relative_gap
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) as overall_avg_qty
  FROM invoice_stats
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    s.invoice_number,
    s.avg_quantity,
    s.relative_gap,
    s.avg_quantity - o.overall_avg_qty as qty_above_average
  FROM invoice_stats s
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
  WHERE s.avg_quantity > o.overall_avg_qty
)
SELECT 
  invoice_number,
  avg_quantity,
  relative_gap,
  qty_above_average
FROM filtered
ORDER BY qty_above_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity (VARCHAR(50)) is numeric or cast-compatible; non-numeric values will cause CAST to fail or behave unexpectedly
The relative gap per invoice aggregates costs at invoice level: (SUM(derived_product_cost) − SUM(derived_total_cost)) ÷ SUM(derived_total_cost), rather than averaging line-item-level gaps

alternatives.interpretation: The relative gap is the average of per-line-item gaps rather than an invoice-level aggregate
